2026_03_LV_NO.headline: Shough-Olave surge meets unbeaten Raiders with Bowers managing knee issue
2026_03_LV_NO.paragraph1: New Orleans brings one of the league's hottest passing attacks into its home opener, with Tyler Shough leading the NFL in passing yards and Chris Olave already at 268 receiving yards. Las Vegas arrives 2-0 and must limit explosive completions while sustaining its own offense against the Saints' pressure looks. Brock Bowers has been limited by a knee issue, while Travis Etienne Jr. returned to full practice Friday, making availability and early-down efficiency important to both teams' ability to stay ahead of the chains.
2026_03_LV_NO.model_rationale: New Orleans' explosive passing game challenges an unbeaten Raiders defense, while both offenses need efficient early downs to protect their quarterbacks and sustain scoring opportunities.
